Title: Public Preview Azure Logic Apps Standard Deployment Scripting Tools in VS Code

Body.Content:
We're excited to introduce the Logic Apps Standard Deployment Scripting Tools in Visual Studio Code, now available in Public Preview. With this enhancement, users can streamline the development, testing, and storage of Standard logic app workflows running in single-tenant Azure Logic Apps directly within VS Code, using any source control system.

The Azure Logic Apps (Standard) extension now offers tools to facilitate the creation and maintenance of automated build and deployment processes using Azure DevOps and ARM templates.
